title: Boldfit TitanGrip Pull Up Bar
shortDescription: The Boldfit TitanGrip Pull Up Bar brings pull-ups, chin-ups and core work home without a single screw.
description: The Boldfit TitanGrip Pull Up Bar brings pull-ups, chin-ups and core work home without a single screw. Its heavy-duty TitanCore steel frame holds up to 200 kg, and the MaxGrip Lock's wide anti-slip rubber pads grip the door frame firmly. Foam covers the full length of the bar, so every hand position feels secure. It fits door frames 76–96 cm wide.
highlights: TitanCore steel frame: heavy-duty thickened steel rated for up to 200 kg.
Full-length anti-slip foam grip: comfortable and secure at every grip position, wide or narrow.
Adjustable fit: extends to fit door frames from 76 cm to 96 cm wide.
Built-in spirit level: a bubble meter confirms the bar is perfectly horizontal before you start.
